title: Warrior returns to haunt Hollywood Hogan
summary: Warrior’s arrival forces Hollywood Hogan to revisit his famous earlier defeat. Supernatural-style mind games lead to a WCW rematch of their WrestleMania encounter.

chapters.title: Warrior confronts Hogan on Nitro
chapters.result: Warrior debuts in WCW and confronts Hogan.
chapters.context: His arrival begins a campaign against the nWo leader, later presented through smoke, disappearances and other theatrical effects.

chapters.title: Hogan wins their rematch
chapters.context: The rematch gives Hogan the victory in WCW’s brief revival of their rivalry.
